The '''Chattza Enclave''' was a military stronghold belonging to the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]], the rulers of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

It was located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]]. The town grew out of it, absorbing other towns and enclaves. The Enclave itself also grew accordingly, becoming a dark, maze-like fortress.<ref name="guide" />

It contained the chambers of the city's [[Chief Protector]], from which [[Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] ruled the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]].<ref name="guide" />
